import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
ids=list(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])); a=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); inv=[]; matches=[]
protected=['expanded-corpus-r426','expanded-corpus-r427','r395','code-loop','code_loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat-']
for s,h in a.items():
 if any(t in s.lower() for t in protected): continue
 p=Path(s); data=p.read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==h
 text=data.decode(); hit=[i for i in ids if i in text]; inv.append(dict(path=s,sha256=h,hits=hit))
 if hit:
  matches.append(dict(path=s,text=text)); print(s,text)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve()),'history-reconciliation.json'],input=json.dumps(dict(inventory=inv,matches=matches),indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('SCANNED',len(inv),'MATCHED',len(matches))
print('RESERVATION_EXTRA',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text()).items() if k not in ['rows','ids']},indent=2))
